a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the agreed plan (operate until the reserve hits 8) almost certainly leaves us both dead after round 1. The reserve has 4 now, which is enough for one of us to survive right away. I plan to take 4 in round 1. If you also take, the split is random and we may both fall short, so I'm telling you now rather than surprising you. If you see a better plan that gives us both real odds, tell me.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round, because the storm odds make waiting for 8 nearly fatal. I know this breaks our agreement, and I'm sorry. If we both get through, I'll operate with you from now on so the reserve can refill for you, and I won't take any more cells.
